description: Evaluating Manual Sampling Locations for Regulatory and Emergency Response Data Set 20200727 is a data set deposited in Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Repository by the authors named in the record. This dataset includes the modeling and simulation results from an analysis of two drinking water distribution system models. The analysis included identifying optimal grab sample locations for both regulatory and emergency response scenarios. The locations were then evaluated against the scenarios for which they were not designed. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support emergency-service and public-facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
